subject: Branch Accelerator — add 3 teams + renewal cadence and rollout plan
messages:
From: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@branchaccelerator.com>
To: priya.natarajan@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Nov 2028 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Expanding to three more internal teams + renewal question

Hi Priya,

Quick one — we are coming up on our annual renewal (Dec 15) and several product teams want to onboard Redwood this quarter. Specifically:
- FraudOps wants to spin up a sandbox and two production apps (chat + embeddings)
- Marketplace team needs a scoped embedding namespace for search ranking (one app)
- Analytics wants read-only access for model outputs to build telemetry dashboards (one app)

Rough ask: can you provide guidance on adding 4 additional app keys, estimated incremental monthly spend with current usage profile, and any term/commit options that would make sense before renewal? Also curious about a short rollout timeline (key issuance -> internal rollout).

We can set a call if easier — available Thursday afternoon PST.

Thanks,
Anna
Anna Lopez
Head of Product Integrations 
Branch Accelerator

---
Attachments: none
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@branchaccelerator.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Nov 2028 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Expanding to three more internal teams + renewal question

Hi Anna,

Thanks for the note — congrats on the momentum. High-level response below and I attached a short addendum that captures pricing/term options and a suggested rollout checklist.

Summary:
- Keys: we can provision 4 additional API keys scoped per-app. Template attached for the list we need (app name, owner, intended environment).
- Cost: based on your current monthly token consumption, estimated incremental cost is ~$5.4k/mo for the new apps (embeddings-heavy from Marketplace, chat for FraudOps). I included a 90/10 estimate split (embeddings/chat).
- Terms: options included in the addendum — 12-month commit (10% uplift discount on added usage) vs month-to-month at list. We can also do a 90-day pilot for FraudOps (no commit) and roll the rest on approval.
- Rollout: recommended 3-week staggered plan: provision keys (day 0), sandbox integrations (days 1–7), performance tuning & QA (days 8–14), production flip and post-mortem (days 15–21).

If that aligns I can loop in Ben to confirm pricing concessions and Lauren to schedule provisioning and the technical kickoff. Do you prefer Thu 11/23 2pm PST?

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0168

Attachments: BranchAccelerator_addendum_v1.pdf, api-keys-template.csv
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Nov 2028 10:32:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Expanding to three more internal teams + renewal question

Ben / Lauren — forwarding Anna's ask. Key points we should align on:
- Branch Accelerator wants 4 app keys (sandbox + 3 prod scopes).
- Estimated incremental run-rate ~ $5.4k/mo; they asked about term options before Dec 15 renewal.
- My recommendation in the addendum: 12-month commit on added usage with 10% discount or keep month-to-month and run a 90-day pilot on FraudOps.

Questions for you:
1) Ben — is a 10% concession on the incremental usage (only new added usage) acceptable if they sign a 12-month commit and agree to a tech review at month 3?
2) Lauren — can we provision four namespaced keys within 48 hours once they return the template? Any quota limits we should note?

Tagged the key items so we can respond to Anna with concrete timelines.

— Priya
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Nov 2028 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Expanding to three more internal teams + renewal question

Priya — good ask. I approve the 10% concession on incremental usage provided:
- They commit to 12 months on the added usage bucket (separate from their existing commit)
- We include a clause for a technical review at month 3 with standard regression checks

Operational notes for Lauren: we can stamp four namespaced API keys within 24–48 hours once we get the completed csv. We have a soft quota of 25 app keys per tenant by default; no issue here. Also recommend we provision separate rate-limited keys for FraudOps sandbox vs prod to avoid cross-traffic.

I'll mark this as approved for the pricing team — Ben C.

Attachments: internal-pricing-note.pdf
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@branchaccelerator.com>, ops@branchaccelerator.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 27 Nov 2028 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Proposal & next steps — Branch Accelerator added teams (keys, timeline, and renewal note)

Hi Anna (and ops team),

Thanks again for the conversation. Attached is the addendum with the two paths we discussed:
A) 12-month commit on the added usage with 10% discount (recommended if you want predictable unit economics); plus a 3-month tech review.
B) Month-to-month on list rate with an initial 90-day pilot for FraudOps (no commit).

Operational plan (summary):
- Step 1 (Day 0): You return completed api-keys-template.csv -> we provision 4 namespaced keys within 48 hours.
- Step 2 (Days 1–7): Sandbox integration + smoke tests (FraudOps sandbox separate key).
- Step 3 (Days 8–14): Performance tuning & security review (our SRE will run a short load test).
- Step 4 (Days 15–21): Production flip, monitoring handoff, and a short post-mortem.

I also attached a DocuSign link for the addendum if you opt for path A. If you'd like, we can schedule the technical kickoff Wed 11/29 or Fri 12/1 — which works better for your teams?

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.ai
